description: This file contains a helper object for handling ForeachBatch functionality in Spark Connect servers, including setting up DataFrame caching, managing Python worker processes, and cleaning up resources for streaming queries.

classes.name: StreamingForeachBatchHelper
classes.description: A helper object for managing ForeachBatch operations, including resource cleanup and Python worker interaction.

classes.name: RunnerCleaner
classes.description: A case class for cleaning up Python worker resources on query termination.

classes.name: FnArgsWithId
classes.description: A case class encapsulating DataFrame ID, DataFrame, and batch ID for ForeachBatch functions.

classes.name: CleanerCache
classes.description: Manages cache of query runners and their cleanup for streaming queries, including a listener for query termination.

classes.name: StreamingRunnerCleanerListener
classes.description: A listener that cleans up Python runners when streaming queries are terminated.

methods.name: dataFrameCachingWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a user-defined function to cache DataFrames by ID during ForeachBatch execution.

methods.name: scalaForeachBatchWrapper
methods.description: Creates a ForeachBatch function wrapper that deserializes payloads and manages DataFrame caching.

methods.name: pythonForeachBatchWrapper
methods.description: Initializes a Python worker for ForeachBatch, manages communication, and returns a wrapper function with resource cleanup.
